title: NeoMint Planner Output
description: The model must return exactly one of: plan, clarification, or refusal. The model must NOT include fields like requires_confirmation, permission, risk, or execute — those are owned by the deterministic policy engine.

user_facing_summary.description: A concise, plain-language summary of what the plan will do. Shown to the user before approval.

actions.description: Ordered list of typed tool calls. Maximum 5 actions per plan.

tool.description: Tool name from the tool manifest. Must be an exact match.

arguments.description: Tool-specific arguments conforming to the tool's schema.

explanation.description: One-sentence explanation of what this specific action does.

question.description: A specific clarifying question to ask the user.

message.description: Explanation of why the request cannot be fulfilled, with safe alternatives if available.
